_comment: Identifier First makes this the first screen every visitor sees, new ones included, so the title sells starting rather than greeting a return; login covers the single-step variant.

signupActionText is the one paragraph under Continue, so the Terms and Privacy notice leads it and Auth0 appends the Sign up link; the page escapes this text, so the URLs stay plain rather than links.
The page also collapses newlines, so non-breaking spaces join the words of Don't have an account? to wrap it whole onto a line of its own.
